tools.name: count_memories
tools.description: Count active memories in workspace.

tools.name: erase_memory
tools.description: Erasure v1 (ADR-006): permanently hard-delete a memory, leaving only a tombstone event.

tools.name: get_context_pack
tools.description: Bundled context pack for a task/query.

tools.name: get_decision_graph
tools.description: Decision-record graph traversal.

tools.name: get_decision_review_status
tools.description: Get reviewer status of a decision-type memory row.

tools.name: get_entity_related
tools.description: Entity relationships (bitemporal as-of aware).

tools.name: get_entity_timeline
tools.description: Memories mentioning an entity over time.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Returns daemon health status and version. Cloud exposes an equivalent as a REST /health endpoint only, not an MCP tool.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Fetch one memory by UUID.

tools.name: get_memory_graph_stats
tools.description: Graph size/edge-type stats.

tools.name: get_memory_improvement_history
tools.description: Improvement/expiry job run history.

tools.name: get_memory_narrative
tools.description: Narrative summary of memories for an agent.

tools.name: get_related_memories
tools.description: Entity-graph-adjacent related memories.

tools.name: get_similar_memories
tools.description: Cosine-similarity nearest neighbors.

tools.name: invalidate_memory
tools.description: Mark a memory invalid (soft delete). Local appends an invalidate event to the memory_events log; cloud's memory_delete is the same soft-archive semantic under a different wire name pre-U5.

tools.name: list_consolidation_proposals
tools.description: Pending (or resolved) consolidation proposals from the stage-9 pass (ADR-004): borderline near-duplicate pairs awaiting an explicit merge/keep decision.

tools.name: list_memory_clusters
tools.description: List memory consolidation clusters.

tools.name: list_recent_memories
tools.description: Most recently created memories.

tools.name: mark_memory_used
tools.description: DEPRECATED one-release alias for submit_feedback (U5 collapse, astragenie/memory#671 + astragenie/astramem-local#120). Same handler as submit_feedback; will be removed in a future release — callers should migrate to submit_feedback now.

tools.name: memory_history
tools.description: Full event log for a memory, in append order — the supersession/invalidation/promotion chain. Grandfathered noun_verb exact-match name on both backends (U5 SLICE-A/B decision, not renamed to get_memory_history).

tools.name: promote_memory
tools.description: Promote a memory's scope upward — private -> team -> org (ADR-009). Downward/same-scope requests error.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Top-K semantic recall over stored memories. Alias of search_memory with k default 5.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Record a decision (writes decision-type memory).

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Directly insert a memory into the store. Canonical cross-repo save-contract wire name shared with cloud's memory_save (U4).

tools.name: resolve_consolidation_proposal
tools.description: Accept or reject a pending consolidation proposal.

tools.name: restore_memory
tools.description: Un-archive a memory previously archived by the W4.4 TTL policy or a manual archive event.

tools.name: run_memory_improvement
tools.description: Trigger memory-improvement batch pass.

tools.name: search_decisions
tools.description: Search historical decisions.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Free-text entity lookup.

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Hybrid FTS + vector search over stored memories. Returns ranked hits. Canonical cross-repo name shared with cloud's memory_search (U5).

tools.name: session_digest
tools.description: What I learned this session: per-type counts + texts of memories formed. Defaults to the latest session. Grandfathered noun_verb name (U5 SLICE-B decision) — local-only, no cross-repo naming collision to resolve, kept as-is per the same precedent as memory_history.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Feedback signal on a served/used memory. Cloud: +1/-1 usefulness score. Local: ADR-010 explicit recall-used signal (always signal="explicit"), collapsed onto this canonical wire name from the former mark_memory_used (U5, astragenie/memory#671 + astragenie/astramem-local#120); mark_memory_used remains a one-release deprecated alias.

tools.name: supersede_memory
tools.description: Replace an old memory with a new one: invalidates old_id and links it to new_id via the memory_events log.

tools.name: why_memory
tools.description: Provenance receipt for a memory: evidence excerpt, source session, transcript ref.
